mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, r.day, e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, e.last_name AS employee_last_name, e.mother_last_name AS employee_mother_last_name, e.birth_date AS employee_birth_date, jt.id AS job_type_id, jt.name AS job_type_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN job_type jt ON e.job_type_id = jt.id
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work , r.day, e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id left join branch b on e.branch_id = b.id LEFT JOIN company c ON b.company_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{companyId}

SELECT r.id, r.start_of_the_day, r.entry, r.exit, r.break_time, r.back_to_work, r.day, e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name FROM register r LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN branch b ON e.branch_id = b.id WHERE b.id = #{branchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO register (employee_id,start_of_the_day, entry, exit, break_time, back_to_work, day) VALUES (#{employee.id}, #{startOfTheDay}, #{entry}, #{exit}, #{breakTime}, #{backToWork} #{day})
mapper.update: UPDATE register SET employee_id = #{employee.id}, start_of_the_day = #{startOfTheDay}, entry = #{entry}, exit = #{exit}, break_time = #{breakTime}, back_to_work = #{backToWork}, day = #{day} WHERE id = #{id}
